blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House of Representatives Majority Leader Ferdinand Alexander “Sandro” Marcos has joined political party Lakas-CMD, several sources told reporters. According to different sources, Marcos took his oath as a member of the party in a ceremony last Monday which includes his uncle, former House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez and former president Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, as its members. Marcos will be leaving Partido Federal ng Pilipinas (PFP), the political party headed by his father, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., which lists Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III as among its members.
